sources.name: Open-Meteo Ensemble API — NOAA GEFS 0.25 deg (31 members)
sources.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Open-Meteo); NOAA NCEP GEFS public domain
sources.descriptor: 31-member global ensemble forecast (ncep_gefs025) at 0.25 deg, hourly out to 7 days.

sources.name: Open-Meteo Ensemble API — ECMWF IFS 0.25 deg (51 members)
sources.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Open-Meteo and ECMWF open data)
sources.descriptor: 51-member global ensemble forecast (ecmwf_ifs025) at 0.25 deg, hourly out to 7 days.

sources.name: Computed sun and moon ephemeris (Meeus / Astronomical Almanac low-precision terms)
sources.descriptor: Deterministic solar twilight, moonrise/moonset, lunar disc illumination and low-light dark minutes.

sources.name: NOAA Aviation Weather Center data API: METAR reports
sources.publisher: NOAA National Weather Service, Aviation Weather Center
sources.descriptor: Station observations stored append-only in history/metar: used to score Vis's forecasts and, newest report per station, shown as the latest METAR in the location pop-up.

sources.name: Open-Meteo Forecast API (best-match deterministic models)
sources.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Open-Meteo); free API for non-commercial use
sources.descriptor: Hourly and daily deterministic forecast per point, 7 past days and 7 ahead, for the location pop-up's charts (added 22 Nov 2026). Context only: hazard colours stay on the ensembles.

sources.name: NOAA Aviation Weather Center data API: TAF reports
sources.publisher: NOAA National Weather Service, Aviation Weather Center
sources.descriptor: Each reference airfield's current terminal aerodrome forecast, shown in the location pop-up with its issue time and validity; a TAF whose validity has ended is not shown. Kept in each build's archived locations.json.

sources.name: ERA5 reanalysis (ECMWF / Copernicus Climate Change Service) via Open-Meteo Historical Weather API
sources.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Open-Meteo); contains modified Copernicus Climate Change Service information
sources.descriptor: Daily ERA5 history at 0.25 deg per point: 1991-2020 normals, records for 1991-2025 and a Koppen-Geiger class (added 22 Nov 2026). A grid-cell climate, not the station's own record.

sources.name: Open-Meteo Elevation API (Copernicus DEM GLO-90)
sources.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Open-Meteo); Copernicus DEM GLO-90 licence
sources.descriptor: Station and model-cell elevations for the grid check (since 16 Nov 2026) and the pop-up's site facts.
